episode.logline: Defying Alexander's desperate pleas, Juliana crawls barehanded into the razor-sharp blackthorn garden, enduring brutal lacerations under Clarissa and Gerald's cruel taunts until she unearths the lost emerald signet ring.
episode.continuity_notes: Picks up immediately from Episode 12's climax where Juliana demanded to know where the frozen blackthorn garden was located to save Alexander from the gallows.

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: Whistling winter wind and an ominous low brass drone.
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle macro shot tracking through an impenetrable, menacing thicket of frozen blackthorn briars encrusted with frost.
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Wide shot looking down from the stone terrace. Gerald and Clarissa stand elevated on the balustrade, while Juliana, Alexander in handcuffs, and the Constable stand before the dense briar garden.
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Alexander turns toward Juliana, his manacled hands trembling as he grips her arm.
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: ALEXANDER (Pleading, Agonized):
events.text: "Juliana, look at those thorns. You cannot do this."
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Alexander and Juliana facing each other, his chained wrists held between them.
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up on Juliana's hooded face, her eyes filled with resolute sorrow.
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Unwavering):
events.text: "I must."
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up on Alexander, his combat scar stark against his pained expression.
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: ALEXANDER (Terrified for Her):
events.text: "They will tear your hands apart."
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle shot looking up at Gerald and Clarissa leaning over the stone balustrade, smirking down with cruel amusement.
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana looking up into Alexander's eyes with tender courage.
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: JULIANA (Soft, Reassuring):
events.text: "I will be fine."
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: ALEXANDER (Desperate, Fierce):
events.text: "I would rather face the gallows than watch you hurt yourself for me."
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Two-shot framing Alexander leaning down toward Juliana, fighting against his bonds.
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Gerald chuckling smugly on the terrace above, crossing his arms.
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Tight close-up of Juliana gently clasping Alexander's handcuffed hands, gazing up at him with unyielding love.
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: JULIANA (Emotional, Devoted):
events.text: "You stood beside me when everyone else abandoned me. I will not abandon you now."
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Juliana releases his hands and turns toward the briar thicket. Alexander stretches out his chained hands, attempting to hold her back, but the Constable restrains him.
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot behind Juliana as she walks toward the vast expanse of frozen briars.
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: CLARISSA (O.S.) (Mocking, Vindictive):
events.text: "Careful, sister."
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle shot of Clarissa smirking down over the carved stone balustrade.
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: CLARISSA (Cruel, Sarcastic):
events.text: "That garden has swallowed better women than you."
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Gerald leaning against the balcony beside Clarissa, wearing an arrogant smirk.
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: GERALD (Condescending, Arrogant):
events.text: "Perhaps the beggar's wife will finally learn what her new life is worth."
events.scene_heading: EXT. MANOR GROUNDS - BLACKTHORN GARDEN – DUSK

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Juliana drops to her knees in front of the frozen blackthorn branches, steadying her trembling breath.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the frozen soil at the edge of the briars.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of Alexander lunging forward with chained hands raised high, roaring in fury as the Constable grabs him.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Screaming, Panicked):
events.text: "Juliana, stop!"

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: Rattling of heavy iron chains.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Eye-level shot looking through the thorny thicket at Juliana crawling deeper into the briars.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Juliana crawls forward on all fours, lowering her head under the jagged, arching thorns.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Strangled, Weeping):
events.text: "Please..."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up of Alexander's anguished face as he strains furiously against his handcuffs.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Ground-level shot of Juliana's bare hands reaching out onto the cracked, frozen ground.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Sharp blackthorn spines rake across Juliana's fingers and knuckles, carving bloody gashes across her skin.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's hand scraping against the frost-covered stone, bright red blood welling from deep puncture wounds.

events.label: CLARISSA (O.S.) (Gleeful, Derisive):
events.text: "Look at her hands."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot on the balcony as Clarissa gleefully points down at Juliana, Gerald chuckling beside her.

events.label: CLARISSA (Mocking, Spiteful):
events.text: "The lady has finally found something worthy of her."

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Gerald leans his hands on the terrace railing, sneering callously.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Low-angle medium close-up of Gerald shouting down into the garden.

events.label: GERALD (Taunting, Cruel):
events.text: "Keep searching, Juliana. Your husband's freedom is somewhere in that garden."

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Macro close-up of a massive blackthorn needle stabbing deep into the back of Juliana's bleeding hand.

events.label: SOUND FX:
events.text: Sickening crunch and scrape of thorns slicing through flesh.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Alexander struggling in agony, tears forming in his eyes.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Desperate, Choked):
events.text: "Please... enough!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Wide tunnel shot through the briars as Juliana crawls deeper into the dark, frozen tangle.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Juliana drags her body across the frozen, cracked soil beneath the dense roof of briars.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana's hand getting snagged between two vicious thorns, tearing her sleeve and flesh.

events.label: JULIANA (Screaming in Pain):
events.text: "Ah!"

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Alexander loses control, violently lunging past the Constable toward the briars.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium tracking shot of Alexander breaking into a desperate charge.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Furious, Booming):
events.text: "Stop!"

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Juliana continues clawing forward, branches lacerating her arm and cheek.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana wincing in agony and screaming through clenched teeth.

events.label: JULIANA (Agonized Scream):
events.text: "Ahhh!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium shot of the Constable forcefully grappling Alexander by his coat collar, slamming him back against the gate.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Roaring in Torment):
events.text: "Juliana!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Ground-level shot of Juliana frantically digging and scraping at the frozen dirt and dried bramble pods with both bloody hands.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Juliana digs her torn fingers into the frost-hardened earth, turning over rocks and dead vegetation.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Medium close-up of Alexander struggling against the Constable, his face twisted in grief and rage.

events.label: ALEXANDER (Desperate Shout):
events.text: "Juliana!"

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana lying on her stomach among the thorns, bleeding cuts running down her forehead, cheeks, and bare arms.

events.label: JULIANA (Panting, Praying):
events.text: "Please, ring... you have to be here."

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Her blood-smeared index finger brushes against a solid metallic object half-buried in the frozen dirt beneath a thorny branch.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up macro shot of an ornate antique gold ring set with a massive, radiant emerald resting in the frosted soil.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana's wide, disbelieving blue eyes as breath catches in her throat.

events.label: ACTION:
events.text: Juliana reaches out her torn, bloodied hand and wraps her fingers tightly around the emerald ring.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Extreme close-up of her bloody hand closing around the emerald signet ring.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up of Juliana grimacing in fierce triumph and intense pain as thorns catch her knuckles.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Brief cut to Alexander staring into the briar patch in suspended terror.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Close-up on Juliana's sweat- and frost-streaked face as she grinds her teeth, tears pooling in her eyes, fighting through the blinding pain.

events.label: CAMERA:
events.text: Macro close-up holding on Juliana's bloodied fist firmly gripping the emerald ring against the frozen ground as the episode cuts to black.
